title: Horizon and Terminal
author: Ines Pemberton
blurb: Wendell Ravensworth, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
